Whenever I asked my AI agent for a sign-up form in Flutter, it handed me the 2021 recipe: a listener per field, a dispose() to remember, validation on every keystroke.

What worked for me was shipping an Agent Skill inside my advanced_forms package. One SKILL.md, installed with "dart run skills@ get", and the agent finally stops guessing the API.

Ngl, Dart Skills are cool feature and it made my advanced_forms package even more accessible
